alt: A colorful statue of a woman in traditional Japanese attire, featuring a vibrant yellow kimono with red floral patterns, a green collar, and a striped obi, topped with an elaborate black hairstyle, set against a backdrop of greenery and a tent structure.
A colorful sculpture of three tropical birds, including a macaw, a toucan, and a smaller parrot, perched on a branch adorned with green leaves and pink flowers.
A colorful toucan figurine with a vibrant rainbow beak, yellow chest, and black wings perches on a textured brown branch adorned with twine.
A colorful macaw sculpture crafted from layered, sugared gummy candies features red, yellow, green, and blue feathers, a white face with a yellow eye, and a black and yellow beak.
An elaborate cake designed as a koi pond features a waterfall cascading down chocolate rocks into a pool of blue and white candies, where a large koi fish made of orange and white sprinkles swims.

An elaborate cake sculpture features a geisha figure in a colorful kimono seated beside a black wisteria tree and a cascading waterfall with koi fish, all set against a traditional Japanese folding screen.
